newsitem.title: BRAZIL: SOCCER-RIO DE JANEIRO CHAMPIONSHIP RESULT/STANDINGS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RIO DE JANEIRO CHAMPIONSHIP RESULT/STANDINGS.

text.p: Result of a Rio de Janeiro soccer championship third stage match played on Wednesday.
Standings P W D L F A PTS

Note: The winners of the first, second and third stages qualify for the final round. Twelve teams began the tournament but only the top eight in the first stage carried on into the second stage and only the top six in the second stage carried on into the third.
If the same team wins all three stages they become champions automatically. If one team wins two stages, the final is played between them and the team which wins the other stage.
Third stage winners -- Vasco da Gama
Eliminated in first stage --Itaperuna, America, Olaria, Barreira
Eliminated in second stage -- Madureira, Volta Redonda.
